title: 第五章 源点虚空无的概念第六章 真界虚空现实幻象
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
维度的力量啊，不要说是普通人了，就是世界之中最顶尖的神魔，都可能无法触及半分。
也许这就是为什么，陆羽会感觉到，如果维度力量完全流失，自己将会失去一场天大机缘的原因了。
维度的力量，不要说是陆羽了，就是对于许多强大神魔来说，那也是一个不小的机缘啊。
好在，在陆羽的大胆尝试之下，他将维度的力量，与自己的梦境，心神意志等等，彻底的融合在了一起，彻底的化为了己有。
从此以后，那维度的力量，便是独属于陆羽的能力力量了，可以被外力，连带着陆羽一起摧毁磨灭，但却再也无法被分割剥离。
现在，那一颗无限小的意识灵魂本源奇点，这便是陆羽如今的状态，也是他一切的根本。
在沉思过后，陆羽便将自己如今的状态，称之为“源点”
一切之本源，万物之初始。
随后，陆羽便是准备再次展开梦境。
他的所有一切，全都被融合之后，也并不是就此消失了，而是变得更为圆融自在，可以随意的使用出来。
而且，因为与维度力量彻底融合的原因，当再次展开梦境之后，梦境便会完成一次蜕变，彻底的凝实稳固，再不会轻易的崩溃破碎。
而且，陆羽在梦境之中，还会获得其中的所有力量加持。
如果下一次，再有不知死活的梦魔闯入，陆羽只需要动动念头，便可以操控梦境的力量将其碾碎磨灭。
随着陆羽的念头一动，那一枚源点立即微微一震。
“嗡~！”
一方似虚似实，似真似幻的梦境空间气泡，以源点为核心迅速展开，很快便是重新接驳了，那一方光怪陆离的光雾海洋。
只不过，双方总是有种似融非融，若即若离的隔离感。
“嗯~?！”
透过梦境空间气泡，陆羽清晰的感应到了外界情况，不由微微一愣，这好像与他先前的虚空梦境差不多啊...
或者说，两者原来是一体的，只不过因为维度的力量，陆羽将那一片区域，割裂为了自己的虚空梦境。

那么是不是说，自己的这一个梦境气泡之外，还有着许多其他的梦境？甚至是那种梦魔。
不过，那都与现在的自己没有太大关系。
陆羽能够感觉到，他暂时还无法走出自己的梦境空间气泡，进入那一片梦境光雾海洋，更不要说寻找其他的梦境进入了。
再又感知了一会儿外界环境之后，陆羽便是将注意力收回，放回到自己的梦境空间之中。
无天无地、没有任何物质能量的维度虚空...
“嗯...”
感受着如今的梦境空间，陆羽觉得，这似乎与那传说中世界开辟演化之前的，无的状态十分相似。
当然，那肯定还是有着极大区别的。
不过，这并不妨碍陆羽的幻想啊。
这本来就是他的梦境，稍微想的强一点，设定的高大上一点，又有什么不可以的吗？
“唔~，我这就是无尽虚空！
乃是万事万物，万法万道皆不存在的“无”
的状态...”
“轰！”
而当陆羽说出那些话之后，整个无尽虚空，还有那代表他根本的源点，都是微微一震。
一种属于这方梦境虚空，属于陆羽的概念诞生了。
content_en:
Not to mention ordinary people, even the top gods and demons in the world may not be able to touch the power of the dimension.
Maybe this is why Lu Yu feels that if the dimensional power is completely lost, he will lose a huge opportunity.
The power of the dimension, not to mention Lu Yu, is also a big opportunity for many powerful gods and demons.
Fortunately, with Lu Yu's bold attempt, he completely integrated the power of the dimension with his dreams, mind, will, etc., and completely made it his own.
From then on, the power of that dimension was Lu Yu's unique ability. It could be destroyed and obliterated by external forces, including Lu Yu, but it could no longer be divided and stripped away.
Now, that infinitely small conscious soul origin singularity, this is Lu Yu's current state, and it is also the foundation of everything about him.
After pondering, Lu Yu called his current state the "origin point"
The origin of everything, the beginning of all things.
Afterwards, Lu Yu was ready to start his dream again.
After everything about him was integrated, it did not just disappear, but became more harmonious and comfortable, and could be used at will.
Moreover, due to the complete integration with the dimensional power, when the dream is unfolded again, the dream will complete a transformation, become completely solid and stable, and will no longer collapse easily.
Moreover, Lu Yu will be blessed by all the powers in the dream.
If next time, another dream demon breaks in, Lu Yu only needs to think about it to control the power of dreams to crush it and destroy it.
As Lu Yu's thoughts moved, the source point immediately shook slightly.
"Buzz~!"
A dream space bubble that seemed virtual and real, real and illusory, quickly expanded with the source point as the core, and was soon reconnected to the bizarre ocean of light and mist on the other side.
However, there is always a sense of isolation between the two parties that seems to be in harmony but not in harmony.
"Hmm~?!"
Through the dream space bubble, Lu Yu clearly sensed the external situation, and couldn't help being slightly stunned. This seemed to be similar to his previous void dream...
In other words, the two were originally one, but because of the power of dimensions, Lu Yu split that area into his own void dream.
Does that mean that besides this dream bubble of my own, there are many other dreams? Even that kind of incubus.
However, that has nothing to do with who I am now.
Lu Yu could feel that he was still unable to get out of his dream space bubble and enter the ocean of dream light and mist, let alone find other dreams to enter.
After sensing the external environment for a while, Lu Yu retracted his attention and returned to his dream space.
A dimensional void with no sky, no earth, and no material energy...
"Well..."
Feeling the current dream space, Lu Yu felt that it seemed to be very similar to the legendary state of nothingness before the world opened up and evolved.
Of course, there must still be a huge difference.
However, this does not hinder Lu Yu's fantasy.
This was originally his dream. If he thought a little more strongly and set it a little higher, what's wrong with it?
"Well~, this is the endless void!
It is the "nothing" in which all things, all laws and ways do not exist.
status..."
"Boom!"
And when Lu Yu said those words, the entire endless void, as well as the source point that represented his foundation, was slightly shocked.
A concept belonging to this dreamland void and to Lu Yu was born.
